exam.title: Zoology & Wildlife Visual Assessment
exam.description: Visual knowledge assessment testing animal and habitat identification.

questions.question: Which animal is shown in the photograph below?

image.alt: A wild red fox sitting in golden grass
image.caption: Identify the wild mammal in this portrait

questions.explanation: The distinctive rusty-red fur, bushy white-tipped tail, and pointed ears characterize the Red Fox (Vulpes vulpes).

questions.question: Which visual option depicts a domestic feline?
questions.explanation: Option B represents a domestic cat (Felis catus), whereas Option A is a canine.

questions.question: True or False: Birds possess lightweight, hollow bones that facilitate aerodynamic flight.
questions.explanation: Pneumatized (hollow) bones drastically reduce weight while retaining structural strength for flight.
